subtle_character_push_in.name: Subtle Character Push-In (Dolly In)
subtle_character_push_in.camera_type: Full-frame cinema camera on precision geared dolly tracks
subtle_character_push_in.starting_position: Medium shot framing character from chest up at 2.2m distance
subtle_character_push_in.depth_of_field: Shallow depth of field (T2.0) isolating subject from soft background

movement_timeline.start_hold: Static observational hold for first 1.5 seconds
movement_timeline.dolly_phase: Smooth forward push-in traveling 0.6m at gentle 0.15 m/s velocity
movement_timeline.settle_phase: Gradual deceleration over final 1.5 seconds settling into tight medium close-up

parallel_tracking_walk.name: Lateral Parallel Tracking Shot
parallel_tracking_walk.camera_type: Steadicam / stabilized gimbal tracking alongside subjects
parallel_tracking_walk.depth_of_field: Moderate depth of field keeping both subjects sharp

movement_timeline.lead_in: Subtle organic drift as characters begin moving
movement_timeline.tracking_phase: Smooth parallel lateral truck moving at synchronized walking pace (1.1 m/s)
movement_timeline.end_phase: Camera gently pans 15 degrees inward to reveal destination environment ahead

static_observational_zen.name: Locked-Off Observational Master Hold
static_observational_zen.camera_type: Heavy studio tripod with locked fluid head
static_observational_zen.starting_position: Wide environmental framing capturing room architecture and characters
static_observational_zen.depth_of_field: Deep focus (f/5.6 - f/8) rendering foreground props and background architecture sharp

movement_timeline.duration: 100% locked-off stillness; camera is entirely stationary
movement_timeline.internal_motion: All motion comes strictly from characters, breathing, light changes, and environmental physics

organic_documentary_handheld.name: Organic Human Handheld Breathing
organic_documentary_handheld.camera_type: Shoulder-mounted cinema rig (Arri Alexa Mini LF style)
organic_documentary_handheld.starting_position: Over-the-shoulder framing looking toward secondary subject
organic_documentary_handheld.focus_priority: Foreground shoulder soft, target subject sharp

movement_timeline.organic_sway: Subtle breathing rhythm, natural human inertia and micro-adjustments
movement_timeline.focus_pull: Organic micro-focus tracking matching subject's head turn
